blocks.text: Layout management is used to arrange widgets inside a window in a proper way. It decides the position and size of each widget on the screen. Good layout management makes the interface clear and easy to use. It also helps in keeping the window organized. Tkinter provides different methods to manage layout. Each method has its own way of placing widgets.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Proper layout management helps make applications look neat and work well on different screen sizes.
